Board Summary · Confidential

What We Built
in 8 Months

Get Lucky × Indwe Risk Services — a compact, forward-looking view of what we've built, what we've learned, and where the partnership goes next.

January – August 2026
In short

The original intent stands. We have added a second engine.

Winning affluent golfers for Indwe is still the plan — and it needs time. These golfers are wealthy, already insured, and loyal to brokers they have used for years.

Alongside it we have built a platform, an automated golfer-to-golfer pipeline and partnerships that turn a local sponsorship into a scalable global product. Both run together.

Learned
Volume was never the problem. Of the golfers who gave a reason for declining, 46% said they are happy with their current broker.
Built
A national platform, the world's first hole-in-1 app, and an automated WhatsApp channel that went live 24 August.
Next
Ernie Els, Icons Cup SA and the PGA Show — plus a route to international insurance partners that changes the economics entirely.

04 · The biggest update

We built the world's first hole-in-1 app.

One paid shot at a hole-in-one on every par 3, anywhere in the world. A product that travels, rather than a sponsorship fixed to 30 par 3s.

Live at SA's Top 100 courses — beta 46,000 courses worldwide 47.2m golfers in target markets $10/month, one insured swing

08 · The real challenge

Nobody moves broker on the first call.

01The leads are there. 2,178 golfer leads delivered to Indwe, 1,701 of them contacted.
02Half never answer the phone. 870 of those contacted — 51% — could not be reached at all.
03And the ones who do are already looked after. Of the 306 who gave a reason for declining, 142 (46%) said they are happy with their current insurer or broker.
★ So this is a remarketing game

Appetite for change is built over time, not asked for once.

You do not win a golfer away from a decade-old broker with one call. You earn it by showing up again and again, with something worth opening.

That is what the last four months built: an automated WhatsApp channel, a growing member base, the app, and an events calendar that gives us a reason to be in front of them all year.

09 · Why the partnership makes strategic sense

Eight months into a long game. Now is not the time to pivot.

01We agreed on a long game. Eight months is where a strategy gets tested, not abandoned.
02Get Lucky has evolved — from headline sponsorship to a hands-on sales agency for golfers.
03The brand exposure is already banked. 588,000 golfer impressions at the affluent end of the market, before a single policy is written.
04The model compounds. Members, broadcast, the app, 150,000 golfers — reach that grows season on season.
05Year-1 new business did not land. The assets did — and the international route changes the economics entirely.
★ Our MissionNot just hole-in-1s — let’s own golf. Indwe becomes the go-to broker for South African golfers, and for the golf industry as a whole.

10 · The proposal

Help us go global — and we cut your sponsorship, rand for rand.

01Where we are. Year-1 conversion has not delivered the new business we projected.
02What we built instead. A national platform, an automated pipeline, the app, and partner agreements now being finalised.
03What we are asking for. Introductions to international insurance partners. Your network opens doors ours cannot.
04What Indwe gets. The same access — brand, database, app, pipeline — for less every year, plus the modelled R28.8m brokerage line.
★ The OfferFor every rand of international sponsorship Indwe helps us secure, we reduce Indwe’s annual South African sponsorship by the same amount — rand for rand, to zero.
We’ve built the hard part. Let’s take it global — together.
